subject: Quiet Changes
author: ZombieTron
body:
I have been giving Xandu a really hard time the last couple of days since he mentioned adding Google AdSense to BurnoutAholics.com. But, as you will only see the ads when you are not signed in, I have concluded that, from my point of view, the site is still ad free! 👍

And although we may not be adding much to the site, until the next Burnout game... and as long as the next Burnout game isn't Burnout Paradise 2! 😠 LOL!! Please feel free to add your own musings, as it would be nice if the site still has a pulse, albeit a feint one, once a new Burnout game is announced.

Since becoming a Mum, gaming has really taken a back seat in my life... I was even tempted to start doing a Mummy blog here, but I think I will not bore you all with new words and tantrum troubles and only blog when I have something to say that may interest at least one of you. So, as Xandu said, 'til then, take care and have fun! 😃

subject: BTW, Ive added your website
author: Nero Angelo
body:
BTW, Ive added your website into our description and made note that you are the parent site.. You dont have to be members on FB because as far as Ive heard you two dont have FB, but we thought it was a good idea to create some more social networking among revengers, and as SUFFUR is an admin maybe he can look at it every now and then, just know that it is run by the community and were active in it, so If we find anything that is very much in a negative light or anything that isnt is positive light, such as Threats, Unlawful Activity, Defamation of other people's character, well take care of it and ban whoever started it..

 

It is an open group, but Im thinking more and more about making it closed lol..

Would like to hear both your thoughts as well as Suffurs. :)

"There's Nero, One of the Twin Angels" - DjSubzero18 (Burnout Revenge Online, 3/ 20/ 2009)

subject: FB
author: Nero Angelo
body:
It happened 3 days ago, we went off a suggestion that it would be good to get to know other burners and so that we could plan times to race them in revenge..

So Eurone made the group, but made me the first admin..

Right now we have 8 admins who run it, which is good, because we can all take the responsibility of keeping the site up..

The admins are: Me, Roonige, Binnins, Eurone, Chino, Psych, Stinky, Sonic and Suffur..

The funny part is we just kind of started clicking on who will be admin, so some of us may want or not want that spot, as we didnt discuss any of this with the other admins such as SUFFUR but right now its working good. I made suffur admin as he has a take on this Burnoutaholics website, and Psych is good for updating a lot of things.. We gone pretty well from 15 members to 50 in 3 days and it will probably be more as its been active with everyone talking every now and then..

We would like to make you admin, but you dont have a FB as far as I have heard.. but that would be super cool, as theres always a lot of people in FB and were getting new updates and messages on a daily basis..

 

But anyways the link is http://www.facebook.com/#!/home.php?sk=group_185441061499824

 

So far its good.. it was just started as a way to keep track of people, but its turning more and more into a community page.. :)

 

"There's Nero, One of the Twin Angels" - DjSubzero18 (Burnout Revenge Online, 3/ 20/ 2009)
